What did it earn?
Over the last twelve months, Oct 2025 to Sep 2026, a merchant wind plant in ERCOT priced at the West hub (real-time prices) earned USD 72.23 per kW. The long-run average of 2023 to 2025 was USD 77.52 a year, and of the 7 full years held (2019 to 2025) USD 101.19. At the West hub the price it received, weighted by generation, was USD 23.86 per MWh, USD 6.76 (22.1 percent) below the flat average of USD 30.63: a capture rate of 78 percent.
